description: Offline-by-default pytest smoke suite under app/tests/ plus a separate dev-deps file, covering the bugs this session hit. Depends on FEAT-001 (make_model, estimate_cost live in agent_utils) and FEAT-002 (call sites migrated). Runtime requirements.txt stays minimal; test deps go in app/requirements-dev.txt.
steps: Create app/requirements-dev.txt with 'pytest' (add 'pyyaml' only if a test parses CFN). Do NOT modify app/requirements.txt.

Create app/tests/conftest.py: insert the app/ directory onto sys.path so 'import agent_utils' works when running from app/; register a 'live' marker and add a --run-live option (default off) that skips @pytest.mark.live tests unless enabled, so the suite runs fully offline by default.

Create app/tests/test_model_factory.py: assert make_model('generation') and make_model('judge') return objects whose class name is 'BedrockModel' without raising; assert make_model with model_id='bogus-id' falls back to a valid id (no raise); assert the factory never passes a 'temperature' kwarg for claude-haiku-5.x (inspect the kwargs the factory builds, e.g. by monkeypatching BedrockModel to capture kwargs, or asserting 'temperature' not in the captured kwargs); assert _get_judge_model_id() returns a value in _VALID_MODEL_IDS.

Create app/tests/test_metrics.py: assert agent_utils._default_metrics() contains all of inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheWriteInputTokens, latencyMs; assert estimate_cost(model_id, 1000, 500) returns a non-negative float for each id in _VALID_MODEL_IDS and for an unknown id; add an optional @pytest.mark.live test that runs create_agent/make_model -> chat_response once per a representative agent and asserts a non-empty string (skipped offline).

Create app/tests/test_defaults.py: assert the DynamoDB table-name defaults resolve to m3-demo-customers and m3-demo-orders (import the Module 3 page defaults, or assert os.environ.get('CUSTOMERS_TABLE','m3-demo-customers')/os.environ.get('ORDERS_TABLE','m3-demo-orders') logic). Avoid importing streamlit-heavy page modules at collection time if that fails offline — prefer asserting the default constants directly.

Create app/tests/README.md with a one-line run command: 'cd app && python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python3 -m pytest tests -q' (and note '--run-live' enables the live Bedrock tests).
acceptance_criteria: `cd app && python3 -m pytest tests -q` runs offline (live tests skipped) and all non-live tests pass.
`grep -c 'pytest' app/requirements.txt` returns 0 (dev deps stayed out of runtime).
app/requirements-dev.txt exists and lists pytest; app/tests/README.md has the one-line run command.
Tests cover: no-temperature for claude-haiku-5.x, judge id in allow-list, bogus-id fallback, full metric-key set, m3-demo-* table defaults, estimate_cost non-negative.
verification: cd app && python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; cd app && python3 -m pytest tests -q
findings:
Landed in the working tree (no commit). Offline suite: 10 passed, 1 skipped (the live test). `grep -c 'pytest' app/requirements.txt` = 0 (runtime reqs untouched).

FILES CREATED:
- app/requirements-dev.txt: single line 'pytest' (no CFN parsing in any test, so pyyaml was not needed). app/requirements.txt NOT modified.
- app/tests/conftest.py: inserts the app/ dir (parent of tests/) onto sys.path via os.path so `import agent_utils` resolves regardless of launch cwd; registers the 'live' marker via pytest_configure addinivalue_line; adds --run-live option (default False) and a pytest_collection_modifyitems that skips @pytest.mark.live items unless --run-live is passed. Fully offline by default.
- app/tests/test_model_factory.py: make_model('generation') and make_model('judge') return class name 'BedrockModel' without raising; make_model(model_id='bogus-id') falls back (no raise); no-temperature test monkeypatches agent_utils.BedrockModel to capture kwargs and asserts 'temperature' not in captured even when passed as an override (also asserts captured model_id is in _VALID_MODEL_IDS); _get_judge_model_id() in _VALID_MODEL_IDS.
- app/tests/test_metrics.py: _default_metrics() contains all of inputTokens/outputTokens/totalTokens/cacheReadInputTokens/cacheWriteInputTokens/latencyMs (subset check); estimate_cost(id,1000,500) is a non-negative float for every id in _VALID_MODEL_IDS and for an unknown id; plus an optional @pytest.mark.live test that create_agent -> chat_response and asserts a non-empty string (skipped offline).
- app/tests/test_defaults.py: asserts the m3-demo-customers / m3-demo-orders default-resolution logic via os.environ.get(...,default) directly. Deliberately does NOT import pages/3_Module_3_Security.py (imports streamlit at module scope, unavailable/heavy offline) — matches the FEAT-004 guidance to assert default constants directly.
- app/tests/README.md: one-line run command (pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python3 -m pytest tests -q) plus a note that --run-live enables the live Bedrock tests.

NOTE: BedrockModel construction is offline-safe, so the model-factory tests build real BedrockModel objects without hitting AWS. No AWS calls made, no Streamlit server started, no commit/push/deploy.
